definitions.labels: never modified; wrong decisions judged against original labels
definitions.ungated: SAME model/preprocessing/imputation/inputs/population with both gates bypassed; invalid inputs scored via frozen median imputation (never crashes)
definitions.window_block_rule: PSI >= 0.25 on ≥1 feature → entire window falls back (psi.py standard ALERT threshold, reused unchanged)
